evidence.quote: The fees for international students from non-EU countries amount to €1,500 per semester.
The following tuition fees apply for applicants from: non-EU countries 1,500 EUR

notes: The tuition fee of €1,500 per semester is stated for international students from non-EU countries and applies to this programme (listed under 'Study programs with fees for international students from third countries'). The application deadline 30 September 2026 is given for applicants from all countries; no separate non-EU deadline is stated. The programme's own page gives no explicit application platform; the international-applicants page states that applicants with a foreign qualification must have their certificates assessed via a VPD from uni-assist, so the channel is recorded as de-uni-assist-vpd. The TestAS requirement appears only in the FAQ and contradicts the main admission requirements list; it is therefore recorded as a manual_check. The FAQ quote is two sentences long but kept for context; the requirement itself is in the first sentence.

note.fr: La FAQ indique que les candidats internationaux doivent aussi fournir un certificat TestAS. À vérifier.
note.en: The FAQ states international applicants also require a TestAS certificate. To be verified.

evidence.quote: To study Mechanical Engineering with us, you only need a university entrance qualification and English language skills at level B2. International applicants also require a TestAS certificate.
